findings.title: Testing guide misses four tidy-up points
findings.problem: Story AC7 requires both docs/testing.md and testing-patterns.md:136 to describe the tidy-up. docs/testing.md covers all seven points, but the guide bullet at line 136 leaves out four: what the E2E_KEEP_DATA=1 opt-out is for (keeping a failed journey's rows to inspect), that a Codespace's forwarded address gets no tidy-up, that someone running npm run dev with their own database address must set E2E_DATABASE_URL to the same value, and that the journeys should run one at a time against a shop.
findings.impact: A required story criterion ships partial. Coding agents load this guide before docs/testing.md, so they would miss the Codespace limit and the E2E_DATABASE_URL instruction and could expect a tidy-up that never runs against their own dev database.
findings.recommendation: Extend the tidy-up bullet at testing-patterns.md:136 to cover the four missing AC7 points, matching docs/testing.md: the opt-out (E2E_KEEP_DATA=1) exists to keep a failed journey's rows for inspection; a Codespace's forwarded address gets no tidy-up; someone running `npm run dev` with their own database address must set E2E_DATABASE_URL to the same value; run the journeys one at a time against a shop.
findings.check_notes: testing-patterns.md:136 now states the E2E_KEEP_DATA=1 inspection purpose, Codespace no-tidy, E2E_DATABASE_URL for own dev DB, and one run at a time

fix.change: testing-patterns.md journeys bullet now covers the opt-out's purpose, no tidy-up for a Codespace, setting E2E_DATABASE_URL to match a custom npm run dev database, and running journeys one at a time

findings.title: Database host check bypassed by host query
findings.problem: decideTidy checks only new URL(databaseUrl).hostname against localhost/127.0.0.1. pg-connection-string (node_modules/pg-connection-string/index.js:40-56) copies every query parameter into the config and lets a host query parameter win over the URL hostname, so E2E_DATABASE_URL=postgres://u:p@localhost/griffin?host=db.example.com passes the local-only check while pg connects to db.example.com.
findings.impact: The guard that is meant to keep the destructive tidy-up away from any database not on this machine can be bypassed by a connection string the check reads as local; the four DELETEs then run against a remote database. This breaks AC5's intent and the spec decision that only a local database is tidied.
findings.recommendation: In decideTidy, also refuse (or check against LOCAL_HOSTS) any `host` or `hostaddr` query parameter in the database URL, e.g. `const params = new URL(databaseUrl).searchParams; if (params.has('host') || params.has('hostaddr')) return { run: false, message: ... }` naming only the host; add a tidy.test.ts case for `postgres://u:p@localhost/griffin?host=db.example.com`.
findings.check_notes: tidy.ts:41-48 checks URL hostname plus every host/hostaddr query value against LOCAL_HOSTS; tidy.test.ts:28-40 covers both params and a local host query

fix.change: decideTidy also checks every host and hostaddr query parameter against LOCAL_HOSTS and skips, naming only that host, when any is not local
fix.test: tests/e2e/tidy/tidy.test.ts 'skips when a host/hostaddr query sends a local-looking address elsewhere' and 'tidies when a host query also points at this machine'

findings.title: Keep-data skip message printed twice per run
findings.problem: Story AC4 says that with E2E_KEEP_DATA=1 the run says so in one line. Both global-setup.ts and global-teardown.ts call runTidyUp, and each logs decideTidy's skip message (tidy.ts:60-61), so one run prints the line twice. tidy.test.ts checks a single hook only, so it does not catch this.
findings.impact: A required story criterion ships partial: the run output repeats the opt-out notice, which is not what the story asked for and is untested.
findings.recommendation: Make a run with E2E_KEEP_DATA=1 print the skip line once, e.g. log the keep-data message only when `when === 'start'` (end hook stays silent for that reason only), and add a tidy.test.ts case running both hooks and asserting one line.
findings.check_notes: tidy.ts:66-67 end hook skips logging under E2E_KEEP_DATA=1; tidy.test.ts:88-94 runs both hooks and asserts exactly one line

fix.change: runTidyUp stays silent in the end hook when E2E_KEEP_DATA=1, so a run prints the skip line once
fix.test: tests/e2e/tidy/tidy.test.ts 'says E2E_KEEP_DATA=1 skipped it only once across both hooks of a run'

final_round.rationale: Balanced profile: edge-case, acceptance and standards ran (blind and verification-gap not in this profile); every candidate was checked against source. Three blockers: story AC4 and AC7 are partial, and a ?host= query in E2E_DATABASE_URL bypasses the local-only database check. 0 deferred; 4 edge-case candidates dismissed (KEEP_DATA values other than 1 match the spec, ROLLBACK error masking is diagnostic only, idle-connection error has no real window, schema list matches AC9).
